//: Resolution-only tsconfig for the boundary gate. dependency-cruiser takes ONE tsconfig for the whole cruise, but path aliases live in per-app tsconfigs — so the aliases the gate must be able to follow are mirrored here. Without this, an `@/...` import is unresolvable and therefore invisible to every boundary rule, which would let a game be reached through an alias. Keep in step with the `paths` of each app tsconfig; the `not-to-unresolvable` warning in .dependency-cruiser.cjs is what tells you it has drifted. This file is never used to compile anything.
